title: Token Surgeon: Compact Cost Summaries & Export Microinteractions
creator: Aisha Fernandez
description: Design a compact, scannable token-level cost summary panel and a lightweight export microflow for Redwood Console. The goal is to let engineers and finance users quickly understand per-request token cost breakdowns, attribute spend to routes/models/users, and export compact CSV/JSON artifacts with contextual metadata. Deliverables: Figma prototype for the compact panel, high-fidelity export modal, updated design system tokens for condensed tables, and a short interaction spec for developers explaining caching of computed attributions and pagination behavior for large exports.
acceptance_criteria: Compact token summary panel fits into existing per-route dashboard without vertical overflow at 1024px width
Panel shows per-message token counts, effective per-token price, discount/quantization adjustments, and attribution tags (route, model, user) in a single row
Hover reveals inline sparklines for token distribution and a CTA to dive into full cost drilldowns
Export modal supports CSV and JSON, preserves attribution tags, includes sampling metadata (prefix-cache hits, kv-cache reuse rate), and provides an estimated file size before export
Design handoff includes component props, accessible color contrast tokens, and edge-case states (missing billing metadata, partial attribution due to anonymized requests)
